about: Import v2 gold set (Phase 1, section A). Each case: the URL, the date read, the verbatim source span, what a TEXT tier should return (expected.status, expected.textSeed), the true pan where the page states it (expected.seed; null when the page does not settle it), the vision reading for image-only pages (expected.visionSeed), and the reasoning. Spans are quoted verbatim but kept short: the pitch line or lines plus the few words needed to read them (labels, the ding marker); '...' marks an elision. They are kept short because GitHub Pages serves every committed file, docs/plans included, publicly (owner decision 2026-10-18). Scores do not count until the owner spot-checks this file (O6).
